label: Cursor position
description: Read where the mouse is on the computer's screen, in screen pixels. It runs when `computer` arrives: in a tool loop, gate it on RouteComputerCall's `cursor` port through `_should_flow`.

inputs.name: computer
inputs.description: The `computer` output of the Computer node to act on.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: The position as a model reads it back, `X=512, Y=384`.

metadataPorts.name: tools
metadataPorts.description: The tools a model calls this node through, in Anthropic's names and in OpenAI's: gather them up to the LLM node's `tools` through metadata ports.

anthropic.description: Tell where the mouse is, as X=..., Y=....
anthropic.name: cursor_position
